offering_description.value: Makes and sells razors, shaving supplies, sunscreens, skin care products and personal cleansing wipes for consumers. It reaches shoppers through retail chains, distributors and online stores.

primary_products.value: razors and replacement blades; shaving gels and creams; sunscreens and after-sun products; skin care and grooming products; personal cleansing wipes

customer_segment.value: B2B: Mass merchants, pharmacies, supermarkets, club stores and online retailers; B2C: Shoppers buying shaving, sun care and grooming products directly online

end_markets.value: shaving and grooming; sun protection; skin care; personal hygiene

revenue_model.value: product sales: Razors, shaving supplies, sunscreens, skin care products and wipes; subscription: Scheduled razor blade refills

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Turns blades, plastics and formulation ingredients into shaving and personal care products for retailers, distributors and consumers

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Europe, Asia and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: Wet shaving, sun protection, skin care and personal cleansing

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: Mass merchants, drugstores, supermarkets and warehouse clubs; direct sales: Wholesale accounts with major retail chains; distributors / dealers: Wholesale distributors serving retail outlets in international markets; online: Online marketplaces, retailer websites and company-operated brand stores
distribution_channels.category: third-party retail; direct sales; distributors / dealers; online

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FDA over-the-counter sunscreen rules, cosmetics safety and labeling requirements, and manufacturing safety standards
